description:
ROOT CAUSE of opaque_fn_value_join build/run failure (fault 4). derive_codegen_seam_facts forced every lane of a callable boundary that escapes into fz value space to ValueRef (boxed_first_class / boundary_escapes_into_fz_space). But the boxed closure-apply wrapper TAIL-CALLS the target body, so it cannot rebox the return; the continuation that consumes the result is already derived from the body's grounded return repr (ReturnDelivery / ReturnContinuation = codegen_repr_for_lane). Forcing the return lane to ValueRef desynchronized the wrapper's declared return ([ValueRef]) from the body's actual return ([RawInt]) -> 'callable boundary N return lanes must match target body lanes exactly'.

FIX (correct-by-construction removal): a callable-boundary lane carries the target body's grounded repr (codegen_repr_for_lane), always. The boxed apply wrapper is the SOLE boxing seam: it accepts the uniform i64 closure-apply ABI from any first-class caller and unboxes each capture/arg lane to the body's repr before tail-calling it. The generic caller never needs to know the convention -- the wrapper bridges. Deleted boxed_first_class + boundary_escapes_into_fz_space (dead).

SUPERSEDES the fz-1m2 typed-dispatch epic: empirically a phi of same-signature callables is called from the GENERIC Enumerable.reduce protocol lambda via boxed_indirect; that caller has no boundary mapping and cannot dispatch typed, so a typed call_indirect at the body entry is unreachable there. Removing the over-boxing fixes the bug with no new machinery.

VERIFY: opaque_fn_value_join build+run+interp green (no per-step heap alloc); fixture matrix 337/0; lib 2216/0; clippy clean. Updated compiler2_abi_ready_callable_entries_read_boundary_seam_facts to the grounded-repr model; updated .agent/docs/pipeline.md.
title: Callable-boundary lanes carry the body's grounded repr; boxed apply wrapper is the sole boxing seam
